description: Defines the class ConfiguredProxyResolutionRequest, which manages an asynchronous proxy resolution request within the net namespace, used by ConfiguredProxyResolutionService.

classes.name: ConfiguredProxyResolutionRequest
classes.description: A final class implementing ProxyResolutionRequest, managing a single asynchronous proxy resolution request, with methods to start, cancel, and handle completion.

methods.name: ConfiguredProxyResolutionRequest
methods.description: Constructor initializing the request with service, URL, method, network key, results pointer, callback, and net log.

methods.name: is_started
methods.description: Checks if the request has been started.

methods.name: StartAndCompleteCheckingForSynchronous
methods.description: Starts the request and checks for synchronous completion.

methods.name: was_completed
methods.description: Returns true if the request has been completed.

methods.name: QueryComplete
methods.description: Callback invoked upon completion of the proxy resolver request.

methods.name: QueryDidComplete
methods.description: Handles post-completion logic, fixing up the result for the user.

methods.name: net_log
methods.description: Returns a pointer to the NetLogWithSource object.

methods.name: GetLoadState
methods.description: Returns the load state of the request.
